_doc: ICE servers for WebRTC, read at runtime next to the page (web) or from res://web/ice.json / user://ice.json (Mac). Edit and re-upload this file: no rebuild. 'stun': plain STUN urls (direct paths through NAT). 'turn': relay servers, the fallback when no direct path exists (symmetric NAT of mobile carriers): each {urls: [..] or string, username, credential}; entries with empty urls are ignored. Example: {"urls": ["turn:standard.relay.metered.ca:80", "turn:standard.relay.metered.ca:443?transport=tcp", "turns:standard.relay.metered.ca:443?transport=tcp"], "username": "<key user>", "credential": "<key credential>"}
